person.bio: I am an M.Eng. student in Vehicle Engineering at Beijing Institute of Technology. My research focuses on generative models, including post-training and inference-time alignment for flow models. I am currently a research intern at vivo's Blueimage Lab.

research.title: FlowSteer: Inference-Time Alignment for Generative Models
research.overview: Designed an inference-time alignment method based on a process reward model (PRM). With generator weights frozen, the method scores, guides, and resamples noisy latent states at arbitrary timesteps to improve human-preference scores.

contributions.label: Process reward model
contributions.description: Proposed and trained a PRM on noisy latents, combining the Plackett-Luce loss for ranking with the Soft Bradley-Terry loss for calibrating reward-guidance gradients.

contributions.label: FlowSteer
contributions.description: Built an inference-time algorithm combining PRM gradient reward guidance with Feynman-Kac resampling. PRM gradients guide candidate-state generation, while PRM scores define the resampling potential for state screening, steering samples toward human preferences.

contributions.label: Experiments
contributions.description: On SD3.5-Medium, achieved 0.97 GenEval, 0.96 OCR, and 23.91 PickScore using 1/3 GPU hour; overall performance was comparable to or better than state-of-the-art train-time fine-tuning methods.

research.title: Industrial Anomaly Image Generation
research.overview: Designed and deployed a Stable Diffusion-based few-shot framework to generate high-quality anomalous images with pixel-level masks, augmenting scarce industrial anomaly data and improving downstream anomaly detection.

contributions.label: Algorithm
contributions.description: Designed a Spatial Conditioning Module that fuses disentangled product and anomaly embeddings with a pixel-level semantic map to control anomaly location and class. Designed a gated self-attention module to inject these conditions into U-Net attention layers, enabling efficient few-shot adaptation of a frozen pretrained U-Net and pixel-level masked anomaly synthesis.

contributions.label: Experiments and deployment
contributions.description: Evaluated the method on two public datasets and multiple private Li Auto scenarios, achieving state-of-the-art generation quality and downstream detection metrics. Deployed the method in multiple production inspection scenarios; it improved detection performance with only 10% of the data required by traditional methods, and enabled anomaly-data generation without real anomalous samples in various scenarios.
